evals.prompt: Analyze a PDF paper containing a model architecture, loss function and detection workflow, and generate a complete Chinese invention-patent first draft. Produce separate claims, specification, abstract and abstract-figure documents. All core equations must be native editable Word equations, and every claim feature must trace to a paper page or equation.
evals.expected_output: A complete Chinese patent package with stable source IDs, evidence ledger, claim-feature map, editable equations, a claim-aligned main flowchart, methodology figures, separate DOCX files, and passing validation reports.

evals.prompt: The paper is a scanned PDF and OCR is unclear for some equations. First organize the confirmable technical solution and draft claims. Do not guess uncertain mathematical symbols.
evals.expected_output: An OCR-aware claim draft that marks uncertain source blocks, excludes unsupported limitations from formal claims, lists specific inventor questions, and does not fabricate equation symbols.

evals.prompt: Compare a paper with an existing patent. Assess support in the paper for each patent claim, identifying material unique to the paper or patent and where patent coverage is broader or narrower.
evals.expected_output: Separate source maps plus a bidirectional feature table using the declared relationship labels, exact locators for both documents, and no assumption that patent-only text is paper-supported.
